candidates.name: Scleroderma

candidates.name: Chronic Injected Material-Induced Sclerosing Panniculitis

Woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region
Foreign-body giant cells and macrophages with large, foamy cytoplasm present
candidates.why: The patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections and the presence of foreign-body giant cells and macrophages with large, foamy cytoplasm are consistent with Chronic Injected Material-Induced Sclerosing Panniculitis.
